regions.decision: Present hides the app's chrome inside its window (no app can make the OS window full screen): the slide on a dark stage, a small control bar with notes and a timer, and an always-visible Exit. Each build step shows its end state; nothing animates.
regions.notes: The show order (deck.show from the current slide) leaves hidden slides out; a slide's build steps come before the next slide. After the last one: 'End of the show'.

regions.notes: Notes opens a strip with the slide's notes under it (deck.slides' 200-character preview, or deck.slide's whole notes when the preview was cut); 'Show notes while presenting' (the Notes segment) starts it open. A presenter layout is a later design.
